pages.title: Fuel Processing Silo
pages.text: Mars did not send a finished rocket. It sent a launch package.$(br2)The $(bold)Fuel Processing Silo$() turns caldera salvage and frozen atmosphere into usable launch propellant.$(br2)You will build the machine, refine the feedstock, and process $(bold)Rocket Fuel Cells$() yourself. ORSA's preferred phrase is $(italic)field expedient launch readiness$().

pages.title: Controller
pages.text: Craft the controller first. It anchors the silo and gives you the processing interface. The shell itself is made from plain iron blocks. Because of course it is.

pages.title: Shell Layout
pages.text: $(li)Build a $(bold)3x3$() iron shell, $(bold)4 blocks tall$()$(li)The $(bold)entire floor$() is solid iron$(li)Above the floor, leave the $(bold)center column hollow$() all the way up$(li)Replace the $(bold)center block on one outside face$() with the controller$(li)Attach any $(l:heating/thermal_heater)Thermal Heater$(/l) to the outside shell$(br2)Higher heater tiers process faster. Capacitors push them harder still.

pages.title: Feedstock
pages.text: $(bold)Sulfur:$() Mine sulfur ore in mature rupture calderas. It drops $(bold)Impure Sulfur$(), which must be $(bold)smelted or blasted$() into sulfur.$(br2)$(bold)Frozen Atmosphere Shards:$() Harvest them in Phase 6 and keep them in a $(l:heating/thermal_container)Thermal Container$(/l) before they sublimate.$(br2)$(bold)Utility loop:$() A sulfur lava bucket can also be reduced inside the silo into impure sulfur if you need to stretch a bad expedition.

pages.title: Processing Chain
pages.text: $(bold)Solid Propellant$(): 4 Sulfur + 2 Coal -> 1 output$(br)Base time: ~60s$(br2)$(bold)Liquid Oxidizer$(): 4 Frozen Atmosphere Shards -> 1 output$(br)Base time: ~90s$(br2)$(bold)Rocket Fuel Cell$(): 2 Solid Propellant + 2 Liquid Oxidizer + 1 Acheronite Shard -> 1 output$(br)Base time: ~120s$(br2)$(bold)Sulfur Lava Reduction$(): 1 Sulfur Lava Bucket -> 2 Impure Sulfur$(br)Base time: ~90s

pages.title: Fueling the Rocket
pages.text: A finished rocket requires $(bold)6 Rocket Fuel Cells$(). Bring them to the blast pit, right-click the assembled rocket with the cells, and load it by hand.$(br2)The silo is the slow part. Budget time, heater fuel, and a second sulfur run if your first expedition went poorly.
